Time-dependent response of hydrogen and methane during plasma-on and plasma-off cycles at 14–18 W. Mass spectrometry results comparing plasma-on and plasma-off conditions at 10 kHz and 137 W average power. Methane concentration decreases by 9.2 percent, while hydrogen and acetylene increase by 8 percent and 52 percent, respectively, validating the non-equilibrium plasma chemistry of the reformer. .......... 9 Figure 11. Photographs of reactor internal components following plasma operation.
